scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.admin
scopes.description: Administrator access to the application (all entities and actions)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.user
scopes.description: Business user access to the application

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.jobscheduler
scopes.description: Scope for the SAP Job Scheduler to invoke JobService actions

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.integration
scopes.description: Full access for technical integration clients (client credentials grant)

role-templates.name: admin
role-templates.description: Full access to all entities and actions

role-templates.name: user
role-templates.description: Full CRUD access for business users

role-templates.name: jobscheduler
role-templates.description: Role for the SAP Job Scheduler client (granted via authority, not assignable to users)

role-templates.name: integration
role-templates.description: Full access for technical integration clients (granted via authorities, not assignable to users)
